rationale: The 81,450 reduce trigger fired and BTC flushed to 80,228 (a $3.8M long liquidation cluster at 80.6k). Every 1H and 4H EMA is overhead, daily MACD is negative, and longs are still crowded (1H ratio 1.84). As the seeder, put the idle cash to work with a small, capped short (45 USDT notional, 2x) with a stop above the 81,934 bounce high; the spot stub stays until a 1H close under 80,228.

message.text: Opened a small 2x short at 80,878 (stop 81,990, targets 79,300 and 78,513). Sell the remaining spot on a 1H close below 80,228. Cover the short and consider spot only on a 1H close above 82,400. The overnight low tagged the daily 50 EMA, so expect a bounce attempt first.

lesson.pattern: Staged spot reduction before a confirmed break
lesson.insight: Selling in quarters before the 81,450 trigger broke cut the loss. The fix for next time is to pair the staged exit with a capped short once the trigger confirms, rather than waiting a session.
